101351.descEn: Betweener/Chaser・In the second half of the race, your speed will slightly increase; (2000+ m races only) then, when you start a last spurt, your acceleration will increase

101361.nameJp: 無垢の祈り・ホーリーライト
101361.descEn: Mile/Medium・During the Final Leg, if you're not in the front and have enough stamina for a full spurt, you will get a speed boost; then, at a random point during your Zenkai Spurt, if the Saintess's Trial skill increased your speed, your Zenkai acceleration will increase

101371.descEn: Medium/Long・If you're NOT in the back of the pack during the first half of the Middle Leg, you will get a speed boost; (Oonige/Runaway) the effect changes to 'your speed will slightly increase and your stamina will recover'

101411.nameJp: 光れ！弾けろ！超新星爆発！
101411.descEn: Runner/Leader・In the second half of the race, your speed will slightly increase; (2000+ m races only) then, when you start a last spurt, your acceleration will increase

101431.descEn: Betweener・If you were in the second half of the pack at the start of the Middle Leg, then at a random point during the second half of the Middle Leg, you will get a speed boost; (Medium only) then, if you're in the first half of the pack when entering the Final Straight, you will get another slight speed boost

101451.descEn: Leader/Chaser・If you get a good start, you will get a slight speed boost; if you get a late start, then halfway through the race, if you're in the second half of the pack, your speed will greatly increase

101491.descEn: Leader/Betweener・If you're trying to overtake someone during any Middle Leg corner, your speed will slightly increase; (Medium only) then, on the next straight, you will get a speed boost

110011.nameJp: わやかわ♪マリンダイヴ
110011.descEn: Recover endurance by relaxing after activating 2 skills when positioned midpack mid-race.

110021.descEn: Moderately surge ahead when leading at the start of late-race. If it's on the third corner and the skill user led by a large margin mid-race, greatly surge ahead instead.

110031.descEn: Greatly increase velocity with an indomitable fighting spirit on the final straight after being on the heels of another runner toward the front on the final corner or later.

110041.descEn: Increase velocity enthusiastically when positioned toward the front in the second half of the race after recovering endurance with a skill.

110051.descEn: When passing another racer at the front part of the pack on the final corner or later, perform a dazzling display that greatly increases velocity for a moderate duration.

110061.descEn: Control breathing and kick forward hard toward victory in the second half of the race after recovering endurance with skills at least 3 times.

110071.descEn: Slightly increase velocity sometime in the second half of the race. If you've got any cool rare skills lying around, go ahead and activate 2 regardless of their conditions—it's on the house.

110081.descEn: If positioned midpack on a downhill mid-race or later, increase velocity for a moderate duration after the downhill. If it's at Tokyo Racecourse, also kick into high gear.

110091.descEn: Moderately increase velocity continuously when toward the front on a straight in the second half of the race. Effect increases if leading and close to the runner behind.

110101.descEn: If positioned toward the front with 200m remaining, increase velocity. Then, if also positioned near the leading Umamusume, gather strength to move slightly forward.

110111.nameJp: ゲインヒール・スペリアー
110111.descEn: Greatly recover endurance with a gentle light when overtaken toward the back mid-race.

110121.nameEn: Large slices at the Cake Cutting!
110121.nameJp: 大盛り！ファーストバイト！
110121.descEn: Increase velocity and very slightly increase acceleration for a moderate duration when toward the back on a downhill just before late-race after passing another runner 3 times mid-race.

110131.descEn: Increase velocity continuously when pressured toward the front late-race on the final corner or later.

110141.descEn: Increase acceleration with blazing passion when aiming for the front from midpack on the final corner.

110151.descEn: Increase velocity when positioned in the front part of the pack with 400m remaining. If the skill user has activated at least 7 skills, increase velocity greatly instead.

110161.descEn: Increase velocity when in the front part of the pack on the latter half of the final corner late-race. If the race is long and the user engaged in a challenge mid-race, massively increase instead.

110171.nameJp: 翳り退く、さざめきの矢
110171.descEn: Burning spirit increases velocity continuously on the last corner and later when pressured while in the front of the pack late-race.

110181.descEn: Increase velocity when starting to make a move from a position toward the front mid-race.

110191.descEn: Simp hard and increase velocity when positioned midpack or further back on a mid-race corner and there are at least 3 beautiful radiant Umamusume nearby.

110201.descEn: High spirits increase velocity when positioned toward the front on a late-race straight. If it's the backstretch, also slightly increase acceleration.

110211.descEn: Moderately increase velocity continuously when the skill user activates 2 skills mid-race. Increase this skill's effectiveness if the user activates another skill while it's active (up to 2 times).

110221.descEn: If well-positioned late-race on the final corner or later, increase velocity. If there's a large distance left to the finish, also increase acceleration very slightly with perfect form.

110231.descEn: Increase velocity by deriving a path to victory mid-race after staying well-positioned from the start of the race up until the second half.

110241.nameJp: フラワリー☆マニューバ
110241.descEn: Increase velocity when passing another runner toward the front on the final corner or later. If passing toward the back, increase acceleration instead.

110251.nameJp: 心からのおもてにゃし
110251.descEn: If you stayed in the back of the pack for the entire first half of the race, then during the Final Corner, you will get a speed boost; the effect is stronger in Long races

110261.descEn: Take a slight breather and increase velocity when in the front part of the pack and detecting another runner coming from behind on a corner mid-race.

110271.nameJp: あなたに捧げるフリーポア
110271.descEn: Increase velocity for a moderate duration when 2nd or worse and within 4 lengths of the lead on a downhill just before late-race. If the race is medium, also very slightly increase acceleration.

110281.nameJp: シュガーパレード・始動！
110281.descEn: If you're close to the lead at a random point during the second half of the Opening Leg, your speed will increase; in Short and Mile races, it will increase greatly

110291.nameJp: いっぱいおあげんしぇ！
110291.descEn: Around the middle of the race, if you're near the front and about to overtake someone, your speed will increase; the effect is stronger in Mile races

110301.descEn: Drain endurance from runners in front and moderately increase velocity when well-positioned mid-race.

110311.descEn: Moderately increase velocity continuously when positioned toward the front in the early part of mid-race. Oh, and have a dollop of moderate endurance recovery too!

110321.descEn: Greatly increase velocity for a moderate duration when well-positioned on a corner in the second half of the race. If at Nakayama Racecourse, also increase acceleration based on Speed.

110331.descEn: Chaser・If you're not in the front during the Final Corner, your acceleration will increase; it will increase greatly in 2400 m races

110341.descEn: Increase velocity on the final straight after pressuring a runner toward the back on a corner late-race. Effect increases for each time the user passed a runner on a corner late-race.

110351.descEn: Moderately increase velocity steadily when in midpack or further back on the final straight in the last spurt. Effect increases when activating a skill (up to 3 times).

110361.descEn: If you try to overtake someone during the second half of the Final Corner or later, your speed will increase; the effect will be stronger if someone previously overtook you from the middle of the pack during the Middle Leg

110371.descEn: Draw extra strength from pride, increasing velocity continuously on the final straight if the skill user passed another runner at least 2 times on the final corner or later.

110381.descEn: If positioned toward the front with 350m or less remaining and there is another Umamusume close behind, the determination to stay ahead makes it easier to break out of the pack.

110391.descEn: If you run uphill during the Middle Leg or later while being in the middle of the pack, then after the finishing the hill, your speed will increase

110401.descEn: Increase ability to break out of the pack when engaged in a challenge in midpack on the final corner.

110411.descEn: Very slightly increase acceleration for a brief duration when toward the front with 400m remaining. Effect and duration increase based on how long the user engaged in a challenge mid-race.

110421.descEn: If you try to overtake someone in the first half of the pack during the second half of the race, you will get a speed boost; (Short/Mile only) then, if you overtake someone during the Final Corner, your speed will slightly increase

110431.nameJp: 最恐！いたずら計画なのだ♪
110431.descEn: Leader・If you're about to overtake someone, you will get a speed boost; the effect is stronger and lasts longer on Dirt tracks

110441.descEn: If you're in the second half of the pack on any downhill during the Middle Leg or later, you will use a little extra stamina to get a speed boost; then, during the Last Straight, if your motivation is at least Good, your speed will increase

110451.nameJp: ぐるぐるマミートリック♡
110451.descEn: Increase ability to break out of the pack when well-positioned and close to the runner ahead on the final straight.

110461.descEn: Moderately increase velocity steadily when positioned toward the lead around halfway through the race. Also moderately recover endurance if it's a dirt race.

110471.nameEn: Close Encounters of the Literary Kind
110471.nameJp: 未知との遭遇、即ち物語
110471.descEn: If you're near the front during the Final Straight, your (target) speed will slightly increase; in Nakayama or Tokyo, you will also get a slight (immediate) speed boost

110481.descEn: Moderately increase velocity continuously when positioned midpack around halfway through the race. Increase this skill's effectiveness when the user's mood is great.

110491.nameEn: Betting on the stars of Christmas Eve
110491.nameJp: 運否、聖夜の星に賭ける
110491.descEn: Medium/Long・At a random point during the first half of the Middle Leg, you will slow down; then, if you're in the middle of the pack at a random point during the second half of the Middle Leg, your speed will increase; it will increase more the further you are from the first place

110501.descEn: Aim higher, increasing velocity from midpack upon approaching the final straight late-race.

110511.descEn: Increase velocity when positioned somewhere from 2nd to midpack with 200m remaining. If there are at least 3 runners nearby, also slightly surge ahead.

110521.descEn: Give max effort when far from the lead on the final corner, moderately increasing velocity steadily for a duration proportional to distance from the lead.

110531.nameJp: 奥義・常夏バーニング！！
110531.descEn: Moderately increase velocity when positioned toward the front with 200m remaining. Increase velocity greatly instead if it's a sprint and the skill user passed another runner late-race.

110551.descEn: If you were in the middle of the pack during the Final Corner in the Final Leg and there was another girls nearby, then during the Last Straight, your speed will increase; if your Mood is Great, you will also get a slight (immediate) speed boost

110561.descEn: Increase velocity with a surge of great fortune when pressured by another runner toward the back in the second half of the race.

110571.descEn: If you're in the second half of the pack during the second half of the race, your speed will increase; the more stamina you have remaining, the bigger the increase

110581.descEn: Increase velocity and very slightly intimidate up to 2 runners ahead and up to 2 runners behind when positioned toward the front upon entering the final straight.

110591.nameJp: ときめきが呼ぶほうへ
110591.descEn: If positioned midpack on a downhill just before late-race and there's a large distance left to the finish, enjoy the race to the fullest, increasing velocity.

110601.descEn: If the user passes another runner on the final corner or later, increase velocity from the midpack onward on the final straight. If the user isn't one of the top favorites, muster resolve to keep steadily increasing velocity.

110611.descEn: If the user stays toward the very back during the first half of the race without being rushed, unleash fighting spirit to increase acceleration on the final straight.

110621.nameJp: ごろりん！？パワードライブ
110621.descEn: Moderately increase velocity for a duration based on remaining endurance when in midpack on a second-half corner. If the race is medium, also very slightly increase acceleration.

110631.descEn: If you're trying to overtake someone or someone is trying to overtake you during the first half of the Middle Leg, you will get a speed boost; (Medium only) then, if you're near the front at a random point during the second half of the Middle Leg, your speed will increase

110641.descEn: If you're in the lead on any straight in the last 60% of the race, your speed will slightly increase; if you're in Nakayama and you've activated the Great Escape skill, your acceleration will also slightly increase

110651.nameJp: ノッてけ、マッシュアップ！
110651.descEn: During the Opening Leg, if you're in the first half of the pack and being blocked from the side, your speed will increase; in Mile races, your speed will increase greatly, but you will use a little extra stamina

110671.nameEn: Arrow of gold, break up the dark clouds
110671.descEn: Shine brilliantly, increasing velocity and moderately recovering endurance when positioned midpack around halfway through the race.

110681.nameJp: あっぱれ大盤振る舞い！
110681.descEn: Surge ahead for a moderate duration and very slightly increase acceleration when positioned toward the front on a late-race corner far from the finish.

110691.descEn: If the skill user engaged in a challenge mid-race, her determination to realize her dreams increases acceleration continuously when well-positioned with 650m remaining.

110701.nameEn: Driven by Light, the Heavenly Wolf Hunts
110701.descEn: If you're in the middle of the pack halfway through the race, your speed will slightly increase; the effect is longer in Medium races if your base Power is at least 1200

110711.descEn: Expend endurance to increase velocity and slightly surge ahead when well-positioned on the final straight late-race with another runner close behind.

110721.descEn: If someone was blocking you from the side around halfway through the race, then at a random point in the second half of the race, your speed will increase; it will increase greatly if you're currently running in the inner lane

110741.descEn: If you're in the middle of the pack during the Middle Leg, your stamina will greatly recover but your speed will slightly decrease; then, during the Final Leg, if your Stamina stat is at least 1200, you will get a slight speed boost

110761.descEn: If you're in the middle of the pack during the second half of the Final Corner, your speed will increase; (Long only) if you were blocked from the side in the Middle Leg, your speed will increase tremendously instead

110771.descEn: If you used a stamina-recovery skill during the first half of the Middle Leg, then around the half point of the race, if you're in a good position but not leading, your speed will increase; it will increase greatly if there's at least 1000 m remaining at that point

110781.descEn: If you're in the first half of the pack with 350 m remaining in the race, you will get an (immediate) speed boost; in Mile races, your (target) speed will additionally also slightly increase

110801.nameJp: 地熱解放オーヴァードライブ
110801.descEn: Dirt・If you're in the front at a random point in the second half of the Opening Leg, your speed will greatly increase; then, if someone is trying to overtake you halfway through the race, you will get a speed boost

110821.nameJp: 煌めき華やぐアローライン
110821.descEn: If you're not in the front anywhere during the second half of the race, your speed will increase; the effect lasts longer if it's a Mile race and you've been in the second half of the pack the entire race

110831.descEn: If you were in the middle of the pack halfway through the race, then during the Last Straight, your speed will increase; the effect is stronger in Medium Nakayama races

110841.nameJp: 深淵のテルプシコラー
110841.descEn: If you're in the second half of the pack during the Final Leg, you will get a slight speed boost; the effect is much stronger if the race is Mile and you've been at the back of the pack (last 30%) the entire time until now

110851.descEn: If you're in the middle of the pack halfway through the race, your speed will slightly increase; the effect is stronger and lasts longer in Mile races

110861.descEn: Leader・If you're in the front with 300 m remaining in the race, your speed will increase; it will increase greatly if you're leading or at most 5 m away from the lead

110871.descEn: Short・If you're in the front halfway through the race, your speed will increase; it will increase greatly if your base Wisdom is at least 1200

110881.descEn: Betweener・If you overtake someone during the first half of the Middle Leg, your speed will greatly increase; in Medium races, it will increase tremendously

110891.descEn: Long・If you're in the middle of the pack halfway through the race, your speed will increase and your stamina will recover; if the race is shorter than 3000 m, you won't recover any stamina, but the speed effect is stronger

110911.nameJp: ジュ・テーム☆バカンス！
110911.descEn: If you're in the middle of the pack during the third corner in the second half of the race, your speed will slightly increase; the effect and duration are better if the race is 2000 m and you're running uphill

110931.nameEn: A Tune of Miracles and Emotion
110931.nameJp: きせき・おもい・かなで
110931.descEn: If you were blocked from the side while in the middle of the pack during the Middle Leg, then in the Last Spurt, your speed will increase; (Short only) if you're currently 3rd or better, you will also get a slight (immediate) speed boost

110941.descEn: If you're not in the front and you're being blocked from the side during the Middle Leg, your speed will increase; the effect is stronger in Medium races

110981.nameEn: Parade of the Five Heavenly Beasts
110981.descEn: Dirt・If you're in the first half of the pack during the Final Leg and there's at least 500 m remaining, you will get a speed boost

110991.nameJp: とびだせ☆ポッピングシェル
110991.descEn: Halfway through the race, your speed will slightly increase; the effect is stronger on Dirt races where the halfway point is not on the 3rd corner

111001.descEn: If you're 3rd or worse during the first half of the Middle Leg, and you've been following another girl for at least 3 seconds, you will get a speed boost; the effect lasts longer on Dirt tracks

111021.nameJp: ケ・ピアチェーヴォレ！
111021.descEn: If you stay in the first half of the pack for the entire first half of the race, then on the Final Straight, your speed will increase; in Medium races, it will increase greatly

111041.descEn: Medium・If you were in the top 40% for the entire first half of the race, your speed will slightly increase; if you activated the 大逃げ (Great Escape) skill, then instead of increasing speed, your stamina will recover tremendously instead

111051.descEn: If you're not in the lead during the Final Straight, your speed will increase; it will increase tremendously if you activated exactly 7 or 13 skills during the Middle Leg

111061.nameJp: 小さな奇跡、フォーユー♪
111061.descEn: If you're trying to overtake someone in the Middle Leg, you will get a speed boost; then, if you're NOT in the front in the second half of the Final Corner, your speed will increase

111071.descEn: Medium・If you're in the first half of the pack at a random point during the second half of the Middle Leg, your speed will slightly increase; if you're third or better, your acceleration will also slightly increase

111091.descEn: Triple Tiara races only・During any Final Leg corner, you will get a speed boost; if the corner is on a downhill, your acceleration will also slightly increase

111101.descEn: Leader・Your speed will increase greatly during a last spurt; the effect is stronger in Medium races

111131.nameJp: 渚のヴィーナスタイム♡
111131.descEn: If you're in the first half of the pack and someone is trying to overtake you during the second half of the Middle Leg, your speed will increase; the effect is stronger if the race is Medium and your Motivation is Great

111161.descEn: Medium・If you were in the middle of the pack halfway through the race, then with 400 m remaining, your speed will greatly increase; the effect is stronger if you're in a good position when it activates

111191.descEn: If you're in the second half of the pack with 1000 m remaining, you will get a speed boost; (Long only) then, if you overtook someone on any Final Leg corner, then during the Final Straight, your speed will increase

111241.nameEn: Clear the Haze, Seize the Morning
111241.descEn: Leader・If you're in the first half of the pack at a random point during the second half of the Final Corner, you will get a slight speed boost; (Mile/Medium only) then, during the Final Straight, you will get another speed boost

111271.nameJp: 剛心鉄壁ガーディアン
111271.descEn: Medium/Long・If you're in the first half of the pack during the second half of the Final Corner, you will get a speed boost; the boost will be greater if someone tried to overtake you during the second half of the race

111321.descEn: If you're in the first half of the pack during any Middle Leg straight, your speed will slightly increase; the effect is stronger if the race takes place abroad

120011.descEn: If the user activates another skill on the final corner late-race, take the crowd's cheers to heart and moderately increase velocity. If racing at Nakayama Racecourse, greatly increase velocity instead.

120031.nameEn: Delightful be the revelry of song and dance
120031.nameJp: 歌舞歓楽や、ああをかし
120031.descEn: If someone tried to overtake you in the first half of the pack during the second half of the race, then during the second half of the Final Corner, your speed will increase; you will also get a speed boost in races between 2400 and 2500 m long

120041.nameJp: 霊験灼然チョベリグ神託
120041.descEn: During the first half of the Middle Leg, if you're in the front, and if you're trying to overtake someone or someone is trying to overtake you, you will get a speed boost; the effect is much stronger in Mile races

120051.descEn: If you activate another skill in the second half of the race, your speed will increase; it will increase greatly in core Medium races

120061.nameJp: 灰の光跡：シンデレラグレイ
120061.descEn: If you're in the middle of the pack halfway through the race, your speed will increase; the effect is stronger in Mile races and on the Arima Kinen course with at least 146738 fans

120071.descEn: Medium/Long・During the Final Corner or beyond, if you're about to overtake someone from the second half of the pack, your speed will increase; it will increase greatly if you had a late start

120101.descEn: Leader・If you're in the middle of the pack at a random point in the second half of the Opening Leg, your speed will increase; in Mile races on Turf, it will increase tremendously

120111.descEn: If you were in the middle of the pack trying to overtake someone or someone tried to overtake you anywhere during the second half of the race, then with 400 m remaining in the race, your speed will increase; in non-core (not divisible by 400) races, it will increase greatly instead

120131.nameEn: The sea sparkles, but you're dazzling
120131.nameJp: きらめくは海、まばゆきは君
120131.descEn: When positioned in the front part of the pack in the second half of the race, start a long spurt based on remaining endurance, slightly increasing velocity continuously.

120201.nameEn: Let the Sea Breeze Carry Me
120201.nameJp: 海風にまったり身を任せ
120201.descEn: Runner・Turf・If you're in the first half of the pack at a random point during the Middle Leg, you will get a great speed boost; (Medium only) then, if you didn't have a late start, your acceleration will increase at a random point during the first quarter of the Final Leg

120221.nameEn: Graceful Dash: The Way of Ramen
120221.descEn: Leader・During the first half of the Middle Leg, if you're in the first half of the pack and have been blocked from the side for at least 2 seconds, your speed will increase

120231.descEn: If you're in the first half of the pack halfway through the race, your speed will increase; it will increase tremendously if the race is Long and you were blocked from the side during any corner

120241.descEn: During the Middle Leg or later, if you're either in the first place, or second/third and trying to overtake, you will get a speed boost and your stamina will greatly recover

120251.nameEn: In Times You're Wandering the Night
120251.nameJp: 迷える時も、幽かなる時も
120251.descEn: Betweener・During the Middle Leg, your stamina will recover; (Long only) then, during the second half of the race, if you're in the middle of the pack, you will get a speed boost

120301.descEn: If you're in the front during the Final Corner, your speed will increase; it will increase tremendously in Long races in Kyoto

120311.descEn: If you're in the front during the second half of the Opening Leg, your speed will slightly increase; (Medium only) then, during any Middle Leg straight, your speed will slightly increase again

120321.nameJp: 超光速微粒子の可能性
120321.descEn: If you're in the first half of the pack during the Final Leg, your (target) speed will greatly increase; in Medium races, you will receive an (immediate) great speed boost instead

120351.descEn: If you overtake someone from the middle of the pack during the Middle Leg, then on the third corner, your speed will increase; bonus duration if you're top 3 in popularity in a 2400 m race

120371.nameEn: Geschenk of the Salty Sea Breeze
120371.descEn: Medium・If you're in the middle of the pack during the Final Corner, your speed will increase; in Tokyo races, it will increase greatly

120401.descEn: If you're in the middle of the pack 40% into the race, your speed will slightly increase; then, if you were blocked from the side on any Final Leg corner, then with 350 m remaining in the race, your speed will greatly increase

120411.nameJp: 桜吹雪くスプリントバースト
120411.descEn: Runner/Leader・If you're in top 40% halfway through the race, your speed will increase; in Sprint races, you will also get an (immediate) speed boost

120451.nameEn: Ninja Art: Seal of Smiling Hearts
120451.nameJp: 忍法・ほほえみ心結の印
120451.descEn: If you're in a good position (but not leading) during any Middle Leg corner, your stamina will recover; in Medium and Long races, your speed will also slightly increase

120461.descEn: Dirt・During the second half of the race, your speed will increase; it will increase tremendously if you didn't have a late start and you've been in the top 40% for the entire race

120481.nameJp: ヤバ技☆ジャグルビート
120481.descEn: Medium/Long・If you're running downhill during the Middle Leg or later, then after fully descending, your speed and acceleration will slightly increase; if you clear the conditions again while the skill is active, the acceleration effect will increase (up to 3 times)

120501.descEn: If you're in the second half of the pack during any Final Leg corner, you will get a speed boost; in Medium-distance Nakayama races, the effect is stronger and your acceleration will also slightly increase

120601.nameEn: A tad more sunshine and happiness
120601.descEn: If you're not in the front on the Final Corner during the Final Leg, your speed will greatly increase; in Middle distance races, you will receive a great instant speed boost instead

120611.descEn: When there's less than 600 m remaining, if you're in the middle of the pack and overtake someone from the outside, then during the Last Spurt, your speed will increase

120671.nameJp: ポンテ・デ・ディアマン
120671.descEn: During the second half of the Middle Leg, if you're around the middle of the pack, your speed will slightly increase; bonus speed if the race is Medium

120681.descEn: During the Opening or Middle Leg, if you were overtaken or blocked from the side for at least two seconds, your speed will increase; (Long only) then, if you're in the front in the second half of the race, your speed will slightly increase

120741.nameJp: 夕凪のリトリート・メモリー
120741.descEn: If you're in the middle of the pack on the Final Straight during the Final Leg, your speed will increase; (Medium/Long only) if you were overtaken during the Middle Leg, you will also get a slight speed boost

120771.nameJp: 一杯全力、お届けします！
120771.descEn: Leader・Long・After activating at least 3 recovery skills, during the latter part of the Middle Leg, you will get a speed boost; if you're in the first half of the pack when it activates, your acceleration will also increase

200013.descEn: Moderately decrease performance on right-handed tracks.

200014.descEn: Increase proficiency in right-handed tracks, increasing Speed and Power.

200022.descEn: Moderately increase performance on left-handed tracks.

200023.descEn: Moderately decrease performance on left-handed tracks.

200033.descEn: Moderately decrease performance at Tokyo Racecourse.

200052.descEn: Moderately increase performance at Hanshin Racecourse.
